title: StreamPlayer
summary: Emby/Jellyfin music and LCD video player for CardputerZero.
description: Browse Emby and Jellyfin media libraries, search titles, play music and watch server-transcoded 320x170 video on the CardputerZero LCD. Supports English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese, local speaker/headphone audio and optional already-configured Bluetooth audio. This reduced store edition runs as the launcher user and includes no root services, sudo configuration, boot/CMA or Wi-Fi changes, or PackageKit/LightDM control. HDMI video/photo output and automatic hardware-decoder setup are unavailable. LCD video uses software H.264 decoding; a server capable of transcoding to the LCD profile is required. Performance depends on the server, network and available RAM. Enter opens or plays, Space pauses, Z/C seek, short Esc returns and holding Esc exits. Configure your own Emby/Jellyfin server and account inside the app.

zh-CN.title: StreamPlayer
zh-CN.summary: 面向 CardputerZero 的 Emby/Jellyfin 音乐与小屏视频播放器。
zh-CN.description: 浏览、搜索自己的 Emby/Jellyfin 媒体库，播放音乐及由服务器转码为 320×170 的视频，提供中、英、日界面。本商店精简版以前台普通用户运行；不安装 root 服务和 sudo 配置，不修改启动内存或 Wi-Fi，不控制 PackageKit 和 LightDM。移除了 HDMI 视频、图片输出和自动硬解配置，小屏视频使用 H.264 软件解码，需要媒体服务器支持相应转码。Enter 打开或播放，空格暂停，Z/C 快进退，短按 Esc 返回，长按 Esc 退出。
